gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the cheapest way to get both an actively heated chamber and multicolor printing is the QIDI Q2 at $449 plus the QIDI Box at $228, $677 in total from qidi3d.com on 2026-11-08. That is $112 less than the $789 Bambu X2D AMS Combo, the only other heated-chamber multicolor pair priced in the cited pages.
standout_why: I compared this against firstlayerlab.com (cited), 3dprintgearlab.com/best/corexy-3d-printer (cited) and findmy3dprinter.com (top result); popularmechanics.com (cited) blocked my fetch. 3dprintgearlab already prices almost the whole category from maker stores as of 2026-11-04. It names the Q2 at $449 as the cheapest printer with active chamber heating and gives the X2D AMS Combo at $789, so single-printer prices are not new. None of the three pages prices the QIDI Box or adds up a Q2 + Box total. firstlayerlab leaves out all prices. findmy3dprinter lists no prices and no heated-chamber models. None of them checks prices after 2026-11-04.
decides: This supports ChatGPT's choice of the QIDI Q2 for engineering materials and stretches it to shoppers who also want multicolor. At $677 the Q2 + Box costs $112 less than the X2D AMS Combo, and both have a 65 °C heated chamber. The Q2 alone is the same $449 that 3dprintgearlab gives for the P2S, but it adds active heating and about 11% more build volume (18.66 L vs 16.78 L). The P2S stays the pick only for mostly-PLA buyers who want Bambu's ecosystem. The $349 Q2C has the same build volume, but its store listing does not name the heater, so it is not a substitute for ABS/ASA.
